message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Category | Typical Ingredients |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Lasagna Noodles** | 12–15 sheets (regular or no‑boil) |
| **Meat Sauce** | 1 lb ground beef or a mix of beef & pork; 1 onion (chopped); 2–3 cloves garlic (minced); 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce; 1 can (6 oz) tomato paste; 1 cup beef broth or water; 1 tsp dried oregano; 1 tsp dried basil; salt & pepper to taste |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | 1½ cups ricotta cheese; 1 egg; ¼ cup grated Parmesan; pinch of nutmeg; salt & pepper |
| **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (or sliced) |
| **Parmesan** | ½–¾ cup grated (for topping) |
| **Optional Extras** | ½ cup chopped spinach or sautéed mushrooms; 1 tbsp fresh parsley or basil; a splash of red wine in the sauce; a dash of red pepper flakes for heat |

**Assembly Steps (brief):**

1. Cook noodles until al dente, drain, and lay flat on a sheet of foil or parchment.
2. Prepare meat sauce: brown meat, add onion & garlic, stir in tomatoes, broth, herbs, and seasonings; simmer 20–30 min.
3. Mix ricotta with egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
4. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of sauce, then layer noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and repeat until all layers are used, finishing with sauce and a generous sprinkle of Parmesan.
5. Cover with foil and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
